# SC1001: circular-dependency

## Meaning

The compiler emitted this diagnostic for circular dependency. The declaration or generated contract violates a statically checkable SupaCloud rule.

## Fix

Inspect the module graph and change the dependency or scope declaration that triggered `circular-dependency`. Keep dependencies one-way and make the smallest shared contract explicit.

## Reproduction

Place the example below in a focused compiler fixture and assert that `SC1001` is reported with a file location. The fixture must fail before the fix and pass after it.

## Failing Example

```ts
// Expected diagnostic: SC1001
@Module({ name: "a", imports: [BModule] }) class AModule {}
@Module({ name: "b", imports: [AModule] }) class BModule {}
```
